projects.name: F.R.I.D.A.Y. — A Virtual Desktop Voice Assistant
projects.description: Developed a GUI-based Virtual Desktop Voice Assistant application to make daily tasks on the desktop easier and reduce human efforts by using voice control. Multiple tasks, such as sending emails, playing music, opening applications, google searches, etc., can be performed by recognising voice commands.
